name: Onodera Yuzuha
source:
A second-year student who is majoring in Foreign Studies.

She is struggling being a student with two part-time jobs. She is from a normal family and has three siblings.

For that reason, she is working hard at her part-time jobs in order to reduce the burden even a little.

She is great at cooking.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/kimikawa/syujinkou]official website[/url]]
